title: A new Evia update is ready
details: Added local Nisi course packs so qualifications can be installed from a .nisi or JSON file instead of being permanently built into every device
Installed packs plug into the existing Evia course context and learner evidence flow, while current built-in courses remain as a safe fallback during migration
Replacing or removing a course pack does not delete learner evidence, RPL, OTJ/GLH or target history
